Proportion PlinkoGrade 8 · Proportional reasoning · 8.5(A)(E)(F)(H)

Set up the game

Answer a released STAAR question correctly to earn a Plinko ball. Drop it anywhere along the top of the board and collect the points from the slot it lands in.

Players or teams
Questions
Order
Three triesCorrect on try 1 earns +100, try 2 earns +60, try 3 earns +30. Every correct answer earns a ball.
Plinko slotAdds 50 to 1,000 more points. Aim for the middle.
Hot streakThree first-try answers in a row doubles slot points.
Out of triesAfter a third miss, a step-by-step tutorial walks through the problem.
Answer correctly to earn a ball

Click or tap the board to drop · Keyboard: ← → to aim, Space to drop
